method_verbatim.value: An esophageal balloon catheter was inserted through the nose into the stomach to a depth of 55 cm, and 1.5 ml of gas was injected through the balloon. The catheter was then gradually withdrawn until an increased cardiac artifact appeared on the pressure tracing (35-45 cm), indicating that the balloon was located in the middle and lower third of the esophagus. The position of the esophageal balloon was confirmed by an obstruction test using chest compressions for passive patients or inspiratory effort maneuvers for spontaneously breathing patients to cause end-expiratory obstruction.

strategy_verbatim.value: PEEP was reduced from 20 cm H2O by 2 cm H2O increments until a value of 6 cm H2O for 5 min and finger pulse oxygen saturation (SPO2) ≥ 88% was maintained. comparator_verbatim.value: The mechanical ventilation protocol for PEEP was based on low PEEP-high FiO2 strategy according to the ARDS Collaborative Group (ARDSnet) recommendations for group G. DPO patients were given adequate pulmonary resuscitation and the 'inspiratory hold' button held to measure the patient's plateau pressure. PEEP was calculated from ΔP=Pplat-PEEP in patients without spontaneous breathing. DP was titrated to below 18 cm H2O for mechanical ventilation.

provenance.quote: titration method (OR=0.03, 95%CI 0.00-0.07, p=0.029) and compliance (OR=0.85, 95%CI 0.74-0.97, p=0.020)

Stepwise regression analysis showed that the following variables were independent predictors of right heart systolic dysfunction: titration method (OR=0.03, 95%CI 0.00-0.07, p=0.029) and compliance (OR=0.85, 95%CI 0.74-0.97, p=0.020)

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS subgroup: all patients met Berlin definition. Obesity: no BMI reported, weight mean 64.1 kg, not obese. Timing: intervention starts at enrolment; unclear relative to intubation. PTP target: end-expiratory Ptp 0-10 and end-inspiratory <25 cmH2O, so both absolute positive and zero ranges.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No check performed as no known cohort clusters in COHORTS.md mention dong_2023. This appears to be a unique single-center cohort.
unclear_items: Sex per arm: Table 2 reports male counts only; female counts not reported per arm, so baseline_by_arm.sex_female is null. Overall female count derived from '24 female' in Results.
ARDS severity counts: text says '28 moderate and 31 severe' but Table 2 sums to 7 mild, 28 moderate, 27 severe. We used Table 2 as authoritative and derived totals.

Table 4: The results text states 'A higher but not significantly different cardiac index ... after 72 h ... (p=0.402)' but Table 4 shows p=0.892 for 72h and p=0.402 for baseline. We recorded table values.
Primary endpoint (incidence of right heart dysfunction) is defined but no frequency is reported; only continuous echo parameters and logistic regression ORs are given.
No information on randomization, allocation concealment, or blinding.
balloon_calibration method coded as 'signal_quality_verification_only' because fixed 1.5 mL volume with an occlusion test for position; no formal balloon filling calibration.
data_only_in_figure: Figure 3 contains OR (95% CI) for right heart diastolic dysfunction, RV dilation, and ACP not fully reported in text; not extracted.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Study compares three PEEP titration strategies; the transpulmonary pressure-oriented (TPO) group is the esophageal balloon-guided intervention. The G group is ARDSnet low PEEP table, DPO group is driving pressure-guided. All groups are non-randomized.
